segments.text: Section 1. You will hear a conversation between two flatmates, Carl and Dave, who are looking
for a third person to share their flat. You now have 60 seconds to look over questions
1 to 10. Now listen carefully and answer questions 1 to 10.
Hi Carl, you got home early?
Yeah, my class was cancelled because Professor Brown is sick.
Oh, I hope he will be fine. I really like his lectures.
Well, did anyone call about renting the spare room?
Yeah, we've had three phone calls about it.
Really? Wow!
Yeah? Do you want to hear about them?
Sure. Who doesn't want to know about their potential flatmates?
Right. The first one was Jack Harris.
Uh-huh.
He's from Newcastle. He's studying culinary arts third year.
great he could take care of our meals actually I'm not so sure about him he's
certainly sounded helpful in terms of cooking but he asked so many questions
about whether we cleaned the house regularly or we took the trash out on
time yeah I mean we don't exactly live on piles of dust or rubbish well not
quite but but he might be a bit too obsessed with hygiene to really fit in
with the sort of life we lead yeah and he asked a lot of questions about the
kitchen he said he needs a fully equipped one you know microwave and
oven and such well that's okay I mean we have all of the equipment kind of but I
doubt they will really satisfy his requirements and to be honest I don't
really want to replace them. I don't think he's the one. How about the second one?
His name is Ramses. That sounds strange. How do you spell that? R A M Z E E S. It's
an Indian name. He's an international student. He's coming to our country to
study information technology. Oh India. I watch a lot of tutoring videos from

but he seems to be quite an introvert you know he doesn't talk much I got the

He's spending a fortune to come here to learn, not to party.
He sounded OK, I think. Oh, one thing though, he said he would be spending most of his time

Mmm, it's understandable that he wants to save some money, but I'm not sure about that.
What do you think?
Well, I suppose it's fair, but it all sounds a bit complicated.
Anyway, there was a third person, Hans Müller. He's from Germany.
Yes?
He's studying engineering, second year.
And?
What did he sound like?
Well, he was really funny actually. He kept me laughing while talking to him.
He said he was so lazy that he didn't want to wash dishes.
That was also the reason why he wanted to leave his current room because his flatmates wanted him to wash the dishes.
At least that's what he said.
Well, that wouldn't be much of a problem here.
We don't cook much and I don't mind doing the dishes.
Maybe he's lazy only in terms of house chores.
Right.
He also sounded like an outdoor type.
He likes cycling and playing sports.
He asked if there was a safe place for his bicycle. That's not a problem.
No. He can leave it in the garage with my car.
So, did you get his contact details? I'm starting to like this guy already.
Yes. His mobile number is 07598208186.
Does he want to move in straight away?
Well, he's paid his rent in his present place up to the 31st of August, but he said, if
possible, he'd like to move in a bit earlier. He said the 29th of August.
And he was okay about the rent?
Yeah, he said it was fine.
Right. So shall we call him and see if he wants to come round? And that is the end
